item.title: Suwa Grand Shrine (Suwa-taisha): One of Japan's Oldest Shrines — Guide
item.description: Suwa Grand Shrine, or Suwa-taisha, is among Japan’s oldest and most important Shinto shrines, with a history stretching back beyond reliable records, and unusually comprises four separate shrine sites spread around Lake Suwa rather than a single location. Each site features four towering sacred wooden pillars (onbashira) at its corners, which are ceremonially replaced every six years during the Onbashira Festival, one of Japan’s most dramatic and dangerous festivals, in which huge tree trunks are dragged down mountainsides and ridden by participants.
